aliases: Relationship between learning outcomes and elements
banglaExplanation: Learning outcome আসে curriculum থেকে, element আসে industry competency standards থেকে।
Learning outcome learner-এর দিক থেকে action statement হিসেবে লেখা হয়।
Element হলো unit of competence-এর basic building block, এটা job-এর tasks বোঝায়।
কখনো একটি element একটি learning outcome-এর সমান, কখনো একটি element থেকে 3 বা 4টি outcome হয়।

example.bn: একটি element থেকে module-এ তিনটি learning outcome বানানো যেতে পারে।
example.en: One element, "Prepare sewing machine", may become three learning outcomes in a garments module.

itemsBn: Learning outcome বলে দেয়, learner কী করতে পারবে।
Learning outcome industry-র ঠিক করা competency standards-এর সাথে সম্পর্কিত।
Learning outcome learner-এর দিক থেকে action statement হিসেবে লেখা হয়, মানে কাজ বোঝায় এমন বাক্যে।
Element of competency শব্দটা industry competency standards-এর ভাষা।
Element হলো unit of competence-এর মূল ইট (basic building block)।
Element বোঝায় সেই tasks, যা মিলে বড় function বা job তৈরি হয়।

short.modelAnswer:
An element of competency is an industry competency standards term. It is the basic building block of a unit of competence. It describes the tasks that make up the broader function or job.
A learning outcome is a curriculum term. It states what a learner should be able to do.
Sometimes one element equals one learning outcome. A single element might also equal 3 or 4 learning outcomes.

realQuestions.answer:
A basic task or function within a unit of competency. It describes a
task that can be performed as part of a broader job or role.
realQuestions.label: Short Questions (Short 31)
realQuestions.question: What is an element of competency?

realQuestions.answer:
An element of competency is a term used in industry competency standards, serving as
the basic building block of a unit of competence. It describes the tasks that contribute to
the broader function or job.
realQuestions.label: Unit 01 Short Questions (Short 9)
realQuestions.question: What is an element of competency?

realQuestions.answer:
What do you mean by the term "Elements of competency"?
Elements of competency or simply elements refer to any subcomponent of a unit of competency
which describe the key activities or elements of the work covered by the unit. They describe, in
outcome terms, functions a person is able to perform in a particular aspect of work.
realQuestions.label: Unit 01 Short Questions (Short 5)

realQuestions.answer:
Relationship between elements and learning outcomes
A learning outcome
•
Is a curriculum term
•
States what a learner should be able to do towards achieving the purpose of
the module/unit of competency
•
Relates to standards of competency identified by industry
•
Is written as an action statement from the learner's point of view.
An element of competency
•
Is a industry competency standards term
•
Is the basic building block of a unit of competence
•
Describes the tasks that make up the broader function or job.
